method.decision_rule: Highest-scoring mapped YAMNet label wins the window; its pattern fires if the score reaches the threshold. Applied to stored raw scores.
method.false_alert_rule: Any pattern fires in at least one window of a negative clip.
method.hit_rule: Target class fires in at least one window of the clip.

input_probes.v1.8.0+bandlimited: Clip resampled to 16 kHz with a band-limited polyphase filter before windowing; the shipped code uses linear interpolation with no filter.
input_probes.v1.8.0+shifted: Windows start half a window (0.4875 s) later.

method.precision_rule: Clips where the class fired and was a target, out of all in-scope clips where it fired.

schemes.v1.7.0: Label map shipped in v1.7.0 (any engine fired traffic).
schemes.v1.8.0: Current label map (traffic is an allowlist of vehicle warnings).
schemes.v1.8.0+V3: Current label map with rule V3 on: a window won by voice fires only if its score is at least 0.30.

method.windowing: Consecutive non-overlapping windows at the clip's native sample rate; trailing part-window dropped; clips cut off at max_clip_seconds.

provenance.dataset_licence: Per-clip Creative Commons licences. Only CC0 and CC BY clips are used; CC BY-NC and CC Sampling+ clips are excluded. Audio not redistributed.

scope: Classifier only, on recorded clips. No wearers, no microphone, no wristband, no real rooms. Not a clinical result.
